lowPoly.title: Fox Courier
lowPoly.brief: A standing indie-game fox courier character facing +Z: pointed triangular ears with inner dark tips, tapered snout with dark nose, cozy hooded neck scarf, bushy curved pale-tipped tail arching behind, and a slung leather courier mailbag at the side. Must include idle and walk animation clips with grounded feet.

lowPoly.title: Apothecary Storm Lantern
lowPoly.brief: A handcrafted brass-and-iron apothecary storm lantern: tiered octagonal base, four thin protective corner cage ribs surrounding a warm glowing ember chamber, domed rain cap with chimney vent, and an open overhead arched carry handle with visible negative space inside the loop.

lowPoly.title: Windswept Cliff Cottage
lowPoly.brief: A cozy cliffside fisher's cottage: stone foundation base, warm timber walls, overhanging pitched gable roof with a raised chimney on one side, a framed front doorway with a tiny porch awning, and a glowing round porthole window facing forward.

pixelArt.title: Sprout Knight
pixelArt.brief: A charming 32x32 side-view indie platformer hero: tiny forest sprout-knight wearing a round moss-green helmet topped with a bouncy twin-leaf sprout, bright glowing visor eyes, warm cloak fluttering behind, wooden round buckler shield on the front arm, and dark boots. Four crisp run-cycle frames with clear leg stride, bobbing sprout, and grounded feet.

pixelArt.title: Alchemist Elixir Flask
pixelArt.brief: A readable 24x24 RPG inventory icon: bulbous faceted crystal potion flask filled halfway with glowing teal-emerald elixir, cork stopper with a crimson-orange wax ribbon tied around the narrow neck, crisp glass specular highlight on the upper-left curve, and a 4-frame bubbling/glint shimmer animation.

pixelArt.title: Ancient Moss Golem
pixelArt.brief: A heavy 40x40 three-quarter front-view ancient stone golem: broad hunched stone shoulders draped with lush hanging moss carpets, sunken dark face cavity with two glowing amber-gold rune eyes, carved chest rune, asymmetric heavy boulder fists resting near the ground, and a 2-frame heavy breathing idle.
